'''The Trial Never Ended''' is the 46th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 1 November 2021. The set consists of 9 virtual cards.

Q's back and as tricky as ever in The Trial Never Ended, a new 9 card First Edition virtual expansion. Along with a number of errata to existing cards, these new ones bring a fresh and modern take to TNG's original trickster. With updated rules and modern wording, it's never been easier to harness the power of the Q-Flash and the Q Continuum side deck with The Trial Never Ended. Just don't forget... Q is mad, bad, and dangerous to know!
